Baan Fun Yim Dental Clinic is located in Soi Chin Khet. The dentist is kind and not harsh, and the staff are friendly and welcoming, like family. The dentist graduated from Mahidol University, so you can trust the quality of service.
If you come during off-peak hours, you can park on the street in front of the clinic, but you need to check the odd/even day parking restrictions as they alternate sides. You can also park in the side alley.
In addition, if you would like to use your social security benefits, you can inform the clinic to claim reimbursement; no upfront payment is required.
